timezone_policy: kickoff_utc is computed from the displayed BJT timestamp. European schedules use Guardian GMT, J1/K League use JST/KST, FIFA U17 uses Qatar local time, and the AFC early match uses Oman local time.
schedule_source_notes: European Big Five: Guardian daily fixture pages, displayed in GMT.
J1 and K League: official league schedule/portal pages.
FIFA U17: tournament schedule cross-checked against FIFA tournament context; local Qatar kickoff converted to BJT.
AFC U17: official AFC schedule PDF; Oman-Kuwait local 20:00 on 20 Nov converts to 00:00 BJT on 21 Nov.
completed_early_review_deferred: The three matches kicking off at 00:00 BJT on 2026-11-21 are not part of the 2026-11-20 review. Queue them for 2026-11-22 10:00.
